Overview

Gangtok is a city in Sikkim with a population of 100,000. The capital of Sikkim, a scenic Himalayan hill station with stunning views of Kanchenjunga, Buddhist monasteries, and vibrant culture. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
